vref_dc.source: VREF is half of +2V8 (R3, R4): a value outside means ngspice settled on a false operating point

ctout_dc.source: U3 follows VREF at DC (C15 blocks its input)

hum_db.source: README, What it must do: at least 12 dB less noise from 150 to 300 Hz, here a 150 Hz hum in time

anti_ratio.source: the speaker answers the hum with its inverse: the anti-noise at the mic within 20 % of the hum
